senses.gloss: ch. [to cover, talk secretly; cmp. לחש,] to curse. Perf. לָט, לְוַט.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 2:8">Targ. I Kings II, 8</cite> <he>לְוָטַנִי</he>; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="L00017"><he>לָאֵיט</he></cite>, <he>לָאט</he>, <he>לָיֵיט</he>, <cite ref="L00442"><he>לָיֵט</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00238"><he>לוּט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 23:8">Targ. Y. I Num. XXIII, 8</cite>, <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 23:8">Targ. Y. II, Num. XXIII, 8</cite>.
Targ. Gen. XXVII, 29; a. fr.—Part. pass. לִיט, לוּט, לְווּט.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:11">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> <he>לוֹט לוטא</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 76:10">Yalk. ib. 76</cite> <he>ליטא</he>, v. <cite ref="L00236"><he>לוֹט</he> I</cite>.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 49a:1">Snh. 49ᵃ</cite> top (prov.) <he>תהא לוּטָא ולא תהא לָאטָה</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>לָיְטָא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, Rashi <he>ולא לטה</he>) be cursed rather than cursing.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 111a:5">Ib. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>מֵילַט קא לַיְיטַת לי</he> wilt thou curse me?—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 113a">Ib. 113ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>ודילמא כי לט יהושע הכי לט</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) is it so that when Joshua cursed (Jericho) he meant &c.?—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17:2">Lev. R. s. 17</cite> <he>לְווּט ביתא באילין לְווּטַיָּא</he> (<he>בגוה</he>) (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 563:8">Yalk. ib. 563</cite> <cite ref="L00442"><he>לִיט</he></cite>) cursed (with leprosy) is the house with such accursed inmates (who refuse favors to their neighbors); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 563:8">ib.</cite> (play on <he>שקערורת</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 14:37">Lev. XIV, 37</cite>, as if <he>שקע ארר</he>) <he>שקיע ביתא באילין לוו׳</he> to ruin goes the house with such &c.
